abstract: We investigate the long-term effects of cash assistance on beneficiaries and their children among participants in the Seattle-Denver Income Maintenance Experiment. Treated families in this randomized experiment received thousands of dollars in extra government benefits for three or five years in the 1970s. We match experimental records to Social Security Administration data using a novel algorithm, finding that treatment decreased adults’ post-experimental annual earnings by $1,800, and increased their disability benefit applications. Effects were strongest around retirement age; evidence suggests possible occupational mechanisms. In contrast, children experienced no significant effects on earnings or interaction with the disability system.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了西雅图-丹佛收入维持实验中现金援助对受益者及其子女的长期影响。在该随机实验中，受助家庭在20世纪70年代额外获得了为期三年或五年的数千美元政府补助。我们采用新型算法将实验记录与社会保障管理局数据进行匹配，发现实验干预使成年受助者在实验后的年收入减少1800美元，并增加了其残疾福利申请。影响在退休年龄前后最为显著；证据表明可能存在职业层面的作用机制。相比之下，子女在收入或与残疾系统的互动方面未受到显著影响。
title: The Long-Term Effects of Cash Assistance
title_zh: 现金援助的长期效应

abstract: Hundreds of thousands of children grow up in the US foster care system every year and are at high risk of experiencing negative outcomes such as incarceration and homelessness. This paper documents how the placement of foster children into families rather than congregate care improves their outcomes using the exits of other children from families as an instrument for their placement setting. Policies that change which children are matched to families can achieve a large percentage of the gains from policies that add families to the foster care system due to heterogeneity in treatment effects.
abstract_zh: 每年有数十万儿童在美国寄养系统中成长，他们面临监禁、无家可归等负面结果的高风险。本文利用其他儿童离开家庭作为其安置环境的工具变量，记录了将寄养儿童安置于家庭而非集体照料机构如何改善其结局。由于处理效应的异质性，改变儿童与家庭匹配方式的政策，能够实现通过向寄养系统增加家庭的政策所带来收益的很大一部分。
title: Who Gets a Family? The Consequences of Family and Congregate Care Allocation for Child Outcomes
title_zh: 谁拥有家庭？家庭与集体照料分配对儿童结局的影响

abstract: Intercollegiate amateur athletics in the US have historically prevented student-athletes from receiving market wages, creating substantial economic rents that are primarily generated by men’s football and basketball programs. Using financial data from college athletic departments, we estimate rent-sharing elasticities to measure how rents flow to women’s sports and other men’s sports and lead to increased spending on athletic facilities and coaches’ salaries. Using player-level data, we find that the rent-sharing transfers spending away from students who are more likely to be Black and come from poor neighborhoods towards students more likely to be White and come from higher-income neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 美国高校业余体育历来禁止学生运动员获得市场工资，由此产生了主要由男子橄榄球和篮球项目创造的大量经济租金。利用高校体育部门的财务数据，我们估算了租金分享弹性，以衡量租金如何流向女子体育及其他男子体育项目，并导致体育设施和教练薪资支出增加。基于运动员个体数据，我们发现租金分享将支出从更可能是黑人和来自贫困社区的学生，转移至更可能是白人和来自高收入社区的学生。
title: Who Profits from Amateurism? Rent-Sharing in Modern College Sports
title_zh: 谁从业余主义中获利？现代大学体育中的租金分享

abstract: This paper provides new causal evidence on the effects of grade retention on educational attainment, behavioral outcomes, and labor market performance by analyzing Texas's reading test–based retention policy. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, I find that third-grade retention significantly reduces annual earnings at age 26 by $3,477 (19 percent). While temporarily improving test scores, retention increases absenteeism, violent behavior, and juvenile crime, and reduces the likelihood of high school graduation. Moreover, retained students exhibit higher community college enrollment but lower public university attendance, though neither estimate is statistically significant. (JEL D91, H75, I21, I26, I28, J31)
title: Early Grade Retention Harms Adult Earnings
title_zh: 早期留级损害成年后收入

abstract: We develop a method for detecting cartels in multistage auctions. Our approach allows firms to act collusively against cartel members yet competitively otherwise. In these auctions, bidders submit initial bids and can later revise them downward. As initial bids are shaded, close initial bids indicate similar costs and thus create strong incentives to undercut rivals. We classify firm pairs as collusive if they ignore this incentive by failing to update bids against each other, relative to other pairs with similarly close initial bids. Our algorithm predicts Ukraine’s Antimonopoly Committee sanctions: classified pairs are nine times more likely to be sanctioned.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在多阶段拍卖中检测卡特尔的方法。该方法允许企业在针对卡特尔成员时采取合谋行为，而在其他情况下则保持竞争。在这类拍卖中，竞标者提交初始报价，随后可向下调整报价。由于初始报价存在折价，相近的初始报价表明成本相似，从而产生强烈的降价竞争动机。我们将那些相对于其他初始报价相近的配对而言，未能针对彼此更新报价、从而忽视这一动机的企业配对判定为合谋。我们的算法预测了乌克兰反垄断委员会的制裁结果：被判定为合谋的配对受到制裁的可能性是其他配对的九倍。
title: Detection of Collusive Networks in Multistage Auctions
title_zh: 多阶段拍卖中共谋网络的检测

abstract: We evaluate a large-scale public preschool construction program in deprived rural communities in Mozambique using a randomized control trial. The program increased preschool enrollment from 2% to 75%, improved primary school enrollment and progression, and led treated children to score higher in cognitive and social-emotional skills tests. Impacts were strongest among children of illiterate parents, in less poor households, and living near the preschools. We provide evidence that preschool construction mediates later educational success at primary school-age. We also detect increased parental investment in children and higher preschool enrollment for younger siblings. Finally, we estimate the program was implemented cost-effectively.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，评估了莫桑比克贫困农村社区大规模公立幼儿园建设项目。该项目使幼儿园入学率从2%提升至75%，改善了小学入学率与学业进展，并促使受助儿童在认知与社会情感技能测试中取得更高分数。影响在父母为文盲、家庭贫困程度较低且居住地邻近幼儿园的儿童中最为显著。我们提供了证据表明，幼儿园建设通过中介效应促进了儿童在小学阶段的教育成就。同时，研究还发现该项目增加了父母对子女的投入，并提高了弟弟妹妹的幼儿园入学率。最后，我们估算该项目的实施具有成本效益。
title: From Access to Achievement: The Primary School-Age Impacts of an At-Scale Preschool Construction Program in Highly Deprived Communities
title_zh: 从入学到成就：高度贫困社区大规模学前教育建设项目的学龄儿童影响

abstract: Using itinerary-level global air traffic data, this paper proposes a novel instrumental variable to estimate the effect of in-person interactions on bilateral trade. By exploiting exogenous variations in air connectivity that are driven by third-country connecting capacities, we show that increased air connections boost trade, especially for complex industries and new products. Online interactions appear to be a limited substitute for in-person contact. These findings confirm the role of in-person communications in reducing information-sharing barriers. Our estimation approach also provides a useful tool for evaluating the social and economic impacts of a complex transport network.
abstract_zh: 本文利用航线层面的全球航空交通数据，提出了一种新颖的工具变量，用以估计面对面交流对双边贸易的影响。通过利用由第三国中转能力驱动的航空连通性外生变化，我们发现航空联系的增加促进了贸易增长，尤其是在复杂行业和新产品领域。在线互动似乎难以有效替代面对面接触。这些发现证实了面对面交流在降低信息共享障碍方面的作用。我们的估计方法也为评估复杂交通网络的社会经济影响提供了有效工具。
title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Global Air Connectivity and Bilateral Trade
title_zh: 条条大路通罗马：全球航空连通性与双边贸易

abstract: We conduct survey experiments to test how the design of scientific grants— the money and time awarded—can be used to manage researchers. On average, researchers are relatively unwilling to trade o! money for time when choosing among grants. However, there is significant heterogeneity in researchers’ preferences. Conditional on receiving a grant, di!erent designs cause only minor changes in researchers’ plans for how they would use the funding. Marginal changes in grant design are more relevant for selection e!ects (funders’ ability to attract certain researchers) than treatment e!ects (funders’ ability to change researchers’ strategies).
abstract_zh: 我们通过调查实验检验科研资助的设计——即所授予的资金与时间——如何用于管理研究人员。平均而言，研究人员在选择资助时相对不愿以金钱换取时间。然而，研究人员的偏好存在显著异质性。在获得资助的条件下，不同的设计仅对研究人员如何使用资金的计划产生微小变化。资助设计的边际变化对选择效应（资助方吸引特定研究人员的能力）的影响大于处理效应（资助方改变研究人员策略的能力）。
title: Money, Time, and Grant Design
title_zh: 资金、时间与资助设计

abstract: Many people are impatient. We introduce domain-specific discounting to a contracting model and test a prediction for how to make incentives work well when people are im- patient over effort: implement time-bundled contracts that make the payment for future effort increase in current effort. Using a randomized evaluation of an exercise incentive program among diabetics in India, we find that time-bundled contracts generate equiv- alent e ort to time-separable contracts at 15% lower cost. Moreover, they perform 30% better among individuals with above-median effort impatience. Pooled across contracts, incentives increase steps by 20% and improve blood sugar relative to a control group.
abstract_zh: 许多人缺乏耐心。我们将领域特定贴现引入契约模型，并检验一项关于如何在人们对努力缺乏耐心时有效设计激励措施的预测：实施时间捆绑契约，使未来努力的报酬随当前努力增加而递增。通过对印度糖尿病患者运动激励项目的随机评估，我们发现时间捆绑契约能以比时间可分离契约低15%的成本产生同等努力水平。此外，在努力耐心程度高于中位数的个体中，其效果提升30%。综合各类契约来看，与对照组相比，激励措施使步数增加20%，并改善血糖水平。
title: Designing Incentives for Impatient People: An RCT Promoting Exercise to Manage Diabetes
title_zh: 为缺乏耐心者设计激励措施：一项促进运动管理糖尿病的随机对照试验

abstract: We study contemporaneous and post-program impacts of a public works program, which provides urban youth seven months of employment at the formal minimum wage with complementary training on entrepreneurship or job search. During the program, we find limited impacts on employment, but a shift toward wage jobs, higher earnings and savings, as well as positive changes in work habits, behaviors, and well-being. After the program, we find no lasting impact on employment or behaviors, with only limited gains in earnings stemming from independent activities. Using machine learning to analyze heterogeneity, we show that alternative targeting approaches can substantially improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项公共工程项目在实施期间及结束后的影响。该项目为城市青年提供为期七个月的正式最低工资就业，并辅以创业或求职培训。在项目实施期间，我们发现其对就业的影响有限，但促使就业向工资性工作转移，提高了收入和储蓄，并在工作习惯、行为及福祉方面产生了积极变化。项目结束后，就业或行为方面未发现持久影响，仅从独立活动中获得有限的收入增长。通过机器学习分析异质性，我们表明替代性的目标定位方法可以显著改善福利。
title: Do Workfare Programs Live Up to Their Promises? Experimental Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
title_zh: 工作福利计划是否兑现了承诺？来自科特迪瓦的实验证据

abstract: This paper builds and analyzes a new global macro-historical database of effective tax rates on capital and labor in 154 countries. We establish a new stylized fact: while effective capital tax rates fell in developed countries between 1965 and 2018, they rose in developing countries since 1990. Multiple research designs at the country, sector and firm-level suggest that trade openness contributed to this rise, by increasing the share of output produced in corporations and larger firms, where effective capital taxation is higher. In contrast to a common view, globalization appears in many countries to have supported governments’ ability to tax capital.
abstract_zh: 本文构建并分析了涵盖154个国家资本与劳动有效税率的新型全球宏观历史数据库。我们揭示了一个新的典型事实：1965年至2018年间，发达国家的有效资本税率呈下降趋势，而发展中国家自1990年以来却呈现上升态势。基于国家、行业和企业层面的多重研究设计表明，贸易开放通过提升公司制企业及大型企业的产出占比（这些企业的有效资本税率更高）推动了这一上升趋势。与普遍认知相反，全球化在许多国家反而增强了政府对资本征税的能力。
title: Globalization, Capital Taxation, and Development: Evidence from a Macro-Historical Database
title_zh: 全球化、资本税与发展：基于宏观历史数据库的证据

abstract: Natural disasters displace millions of people a year, but their economic impacts are difficult to study when the affected population becomes dispersed. This paper estimates the longrun impacts of six landslides in Uganda on nearly the full affected population. The analysis exploits the sharp boundaries between households residing in a landslide path and those on the same slopes but outside the path. Years after the landslides, affected households earn 50% less income and are 18 percentage points less likely to report being satisfied with their lives. Further analysis points to social capital as a determinant of successful post-disaster recovery.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害每年导致数百万人流离失所，但当受灾人口分散时，其经济影响难以研究。本文估算了乌干达六次山体滑坡对几乎全部受灾人口的长期影响。分析利用了滑坡路径内住户与同处同一山坡但位于路径外住户之间的清晰边界。滑坡发生数年后，受灾家庭收入减少50%，对生活表示满意的可能性降低18个百分点。进一步分析表明，社会资本是灾后成功恢复的决定性因素。
title: Disastrous Displacement: The Long-Run Impacts of Landslides
title_zh: 灾难性迁移：山体滑坡的长期影响

abstract: Proponents of labor mobility restrictions argue that innovation incentives more than offset harm to workers. Yet the causal effect of such policies on innovation is an open empirical question. Leveraging plausibly exogenous state-level changes in the enforceability of noncompete agreements, we find a significant negative effect on innovation. This effect is even larger for the most novel and innovative patents and firms. Further analysis shows that these negative effects on innovation cannot be explained by entry alone and instead likely result from reduced knowledge flows. Our findings suggest that labor mobility plays a crucial role in spreading knowledge across firms.
abstract_zh: 劳动力流动限制的支持者认为，创新激励足以抵消对工人的损害。然而，此类政策对创新的因果效应仍是一个悬而未决的实证问题。利用各州竞业禁止协议可执行性看似外生的变化，我们发现其对创新产生了显著的负面影响。对于最具新颖性和创新性的专利及企业而言，这种负面效应甚至更大。进一步分析表明，这些对创新的负面影响无法仅用市场进入来解释，而更可能源于知识流动的减少。我们的研究结果表明，劳动力流动在跨企业知识传播中发挥着关键作用。
title: Innovation through Inventor Mobility: Evidence from Non-Compete Agreements
title_zh: 发明人流动性与创新：基于竞业禁止协议的证据

abstract: This paper provides the first evidence on the impact of exposure to international students on the long-term outcomes of native students. I combine unique survey and administrative data from the Netherlands covering one million students across three decades and employ an across-cohort design. I find that exposure to international students leads natives to (i) form social ties with non-natives, (ii) hold more positive attitudes towards migration and learning about other cultures, and (iii) seek opportunities abroad. Notably, I find precisely estimated zero effects on employment, income, entrepreneurship, and the share of international co-workers up to 25 years after university entry.
abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了接触国际学生对本土学生长期结果影响的证据。我结合了荷兰覆盖三十年、涉及一百万学生的独特调查与行政数据，并采用跨队列设计。研究发现，接触国际学生使本土学生：（i）与非本土学生建立社会联系，（ii）对移民及了解其他文化持有更积极的态度，以及（iii）寻求海外机会。值得注意的是，在进入大学后的25年内，我发现对就业、收入、创业以及国际同事比例的影响精确估计为零。
title: University as a Melting Pot: Long-term Effects of Internationalization
title_zh: 大学作为大熔炉：国际化的长期效应

abstract: We analyze mandatory retirement in Sweden which eliminates entirely employment protection at age 67. Employment falls by about 10 percent and total average earnings by about 20 percent immediately at age 67. 8 percent of jobs separate immediately due to loss of protection, with effects stemming from jobs with stronger initial employment protection (long tenure, firms subject to “last in, first out” rules), and those in the public sector. We examine effects on continuing jobs. While wages appear rigid, we uncover novel, sizable intensive-margin hours reductions, resulting in an 8 percent drop in earnings conditional on staying on the job.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了瑞典的强制退休制度，该制度在67岁时完全取消就业保护。67岁后，就业率立即下降约10%，平均总收入下降约20%。由于保护措施失效，8%的工作岗位立即终止，这一影响主要源于初始就业保护较强的岗位（如长期任职、受“后进先出”规则约束的企业）以及公共部门岗位。我们进一步考察了持续就业岗位的影响。尽管工资水平看似刚性，但我们发现了新颖且显著的集约边际工时缩减现象，导致在职人员收入下降8%。
title: Deadwood Labor? The Effects of Eliminating Employment Protection for Older Workers
title_zh: 枯木劳动力？取消老年工人就业保护的影响

abstract: Do changes in aggregate volatility alter the impulse response of output to monetary policy? I use plausibly exogenous oil price volatility shocks and exploit heterogene- ity in oil usage across industries to show that PPI item level price changes become less frequent and more disperse when volatility is high. This implies aggregate price flexibility does not increase when aggregate volatility is high. I construct a state- dependent pricing model with random menu costs to interpret the findings. Match- ing the new empirical facts, the model shows that increases in aggregate volatility do not substantially reduce monetary policy effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 总体波动性的变化是否会改变产出对货币政策的脉冲响应？本文利用外生性较强的石油价格波动冲击，并借助各行业石油使用量的异质性，发现当波动性较高时，生产者价格指数（PPI）分项价格变动频率降低且离散程度增大。这意味着总体波动性较高时，总体价格灵活性并未提升。为解释这一发现，本文构建了一个包含随机菜单成本的状态依存定价模型。在匹配新经验事实的基础上，该模型表明，总体波动性的上升并不会显著削弱货币政策的有效性。
title: Price Setting and Volatility: Evidence from Oil Price Volatility Shocks
title_zh: 价格设定与波动性：来自油价波动冲击的证据

abstract: We study why government spending and tax policy are procyclical in emerging and developing economies. We develop a model of optimal fiscal policy over the business cycle with financial frictions, captured by asset market incompleteness and debt-elastic interest rate spreads. In a simple static setting, incomplete markets can generate procyclical government spending, but not necessarily procyclical tax policy. Procyclical taxation also requires the ratio of private to public consumption to rise in booms, amplifying tax-base fluctuations. We show that this mechanism carries over to a DSGE model calibrated to emerging markets, implies sizable welfare costs, and is robust to distortionary labor income taxation, downward wage rigidities, and fiscal transfer shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究为何新兴经济体和发展中经济体的政府支出与税收政策呈现顺周期性。我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦（以资产市场不完全性和债务弹性利率利差为特征）的经济周期最优财政政策模型。在简单静态设定下，不完全市场可产生顺周期的政府支出，但未必导致顺周期的税收政策。顺周期税收还需满足私人消费与公共消费之比在经济繁荣期上升的条件，这会放大税基波动。我们证明该机制可延伸至校准至新兴市场的DSGE模型，并产生显著的福利成本，且对扭曲性劳动收入税、工资下行刚性及财政转移支付冲击具有稳健性。
title: Procyclical Fiscal Policy and Asset Market Incompleteness
title_zh: 顺周期财政政策与资产市场不完全性

abstract: We investigate the impact of institutional quality on shielding emerging economies from the Global Financial Cycle. Our findings indicate that countries with a higher rule of law, characterized by superior contract enforcement and more robust protection of property rights, experience a less severe tightening of domestic financial and macroeconomic conditions when faced with adverse global financial shocks. We explain this outcome through a simplified model that incorporates financial frictions, showing how strong institutions and effective governance alleviate collateral constraints and mitigate the effects of global financial pressures on the domestic economy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了制度质量在保护新兴经济体免受全球金融周期影响中的作用。研究结果表明，法治水平较高、合同执行更优且产权保护更完善的国家，在面对不利的全球金融冲击时，其国内金融和宏观经济状况的紧缩程度较轻。我们通过一个包含金融摩擦的简化模型解释了这一结果，展示了强有力的制度和有效治理如何缓解抵押品约束，并减轻全球金融压力对国内经济的影响。
title: Leaning Against the Global Financial Cycle
title_zh: 抵御全球金融周期

abstract: Do changes in the location of trading opportunities cause changes in the location of economic activity? I explore this question using a lifting of restrictions on trade across the Spanish Empire in the 18th century. I combine a difference-in-differences approach with a dynamic spatial model to examine this issue. I find that the reform improved market integration and induced urban growth, but had a smaller effect in locations with larger internal markets. The findings suggest that the location of economic activity adapts to changes in the location of trading opportunities, but persists when these changes are preceded by urban growth.
abstract_zh: 贸易机会地点的变化是否会导致经济活动地点的变化？我利用18世纪西班牙帝国贸易限制的解除来探究这一问题。我将双重差分法与动态空间模型相结合进行分析。研究发现，改革改善了市场一体化并促进了城市增长，但在内部市场规模较大的地区影响较小。结果表明，经济活动地点会适应贸易机会地点的变化，但当这些变化发生在城市增长之后时，则表现出持续性。
title: Long-Distance Trade and Long-Term Persistence
title_zh: 长途贸易与长期持续性

abstract: We study how firm heterogeneity and market power affect macroeconomic fragility, defined as the probability of long slumps. We propose a theory where the positive interaction between firm entry, competition, and factor supply can give rise to multiple steady-states. We show that when firms are highly heterogeneous in terms of productivities, even small temporary shocks can trigger firm exit and make the economy spiral into a competition-driven poverty trap. We calibrate our model to incorporate the well-documented trends on rising firm heterogeneity in the US economy, and show that they significantly increase the likelihood and length of slow recoveries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业异质性与市场势力如何影响宏观经济脆弱性，即长期衰退的概率。我们提出一个理论，其中企业进入、竞争与要素供给之间的正向互动可能导致多重稳态。研究表明，当企业在生产率方面高度异质时，即使是微小的暂时性冲击也可能引发企业退出，并使经济陷入竞争驱动的贫困陷阱。我们通过校准模型纳入美国经济中企业异质性上升的已有趋势，并证明这些趋势显著增加了缓慢复苏的可能性与持续时间。
title: Firm Heterogeneity, Market Power and Macroeconomic Fragility
title_zh: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性

abstract: We present a model in which efficient long-term employment relationships are sustained by wage adjustments prompted by productivity shocks and outside job offers. These wage adjustments occur only sporadically, due to the presence of renegotiation costs. The model is amenable to analytical solution, yielding new insights for several labor market phenomena, including: (1) key features of empirical distributions of changes in pay among job stayers; (2) a near-“memorylessness” property in wage dynamics whereby hiring wages have only limited influence on later wages and allocation decisions; and (3) a crucial role for recruitment and retention bonuses in sustaining efficient employment relationships.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中高效的长期雇佣关系通过生产率冲击和外部工作机会引发的工资调整得以维持。由于存在重新谈判成本，这些工资调整仅偶尔发生。该模型可进行解析求解，为若干劳动力市场现象提供了新见解，包括：（1）在职者薪酬变动的经验分布的关键特征；（2）工资动态中近乎“无记忆性”的特性，即入职工资对后续工资及配置决策的影响有限；（3）招聘奖金和留任奖金在维持高效雇佣关系中的关键作用。
title: Wage Adjustment in Efficient Long-Term Employment Relationships
title_zh: 高效长期雇佣关系中的工资调整

abstract: This study analyzes how firms form their inflation expectations after a regime change in monetary policy and a transition to a low-inflation environment. Using the Bank of Israel survey of firms, we document the basic properties of firms' inflation expectations and examine how Israeli firms update their inflation expectations after receiving new information about inflation or monetary policy. We find that even after successful de-dollarization and disinflation, a positive inflation surprise leads to a sizable upward adjustment in inflation expectations. Our results suggest that managers' experiences keep firms attentive to inflation long after price stability is achieved.
title: Information and the Formation of Inflation Expectations by Firms: Evidence from a Survey of Israeli Firms
title_zh: 企业与通胀预期的形成：来自以色列企业调查的证据

abstract: The U.S. health-services sector has grown both in terms of its expenditure share and relative price. Using a two-sector general equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and endogenous population, we find that relative price growth is almost entirely attributable to increasing relative sectoral markups. Demand effects from aging play only a minor role driving up prices and expenditure shares. Controlling for GE effects and rising relative markups, we estimate that health-sector TFP has grown since the 1980s at a rate greater than 1% annually, dampening relative price growth, while leading to higher health-sector output, partially driving up aggregate expenditure shares.
abstract_zh: 美国健康服务部门的支出份额和相对价格均有所增长。通过构建一个包含垄断竞争和内生人口的两部门一般均衡模型，我们发现相对价格增长几乎完全归因于部门间相对加成率的上升。老龄化带来的需求效应对价格上涨和支出份额增加的推动作用微乎其微。在控制一般均衡效应和相对加成率上升的条件下，我们估算自20世纪80年代以来，健康部门的全要素生产率年均增长率超过1%，这抑制了相对价格增长，同时促进了健康部门产出提升，并部分推高了总支出份额。
title: Health Sector Structural Change
title_zh: 卫生部门的结构性变革

abstract: Black workers experience higher, more volatile unemployment than white workers, a racial dis- parity unexplained by observables. A New Keynesian model with a frictional labor market, endogenous separations, and employer discrimination explains these outcomes. We use the model to assess how alternative monetary policy strategies affect labor market outcomes by race. Switching to a monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to shortfalls of employment from its maximum level instead of deviations raises inflation and does not reduce the racial unemployment gap. A monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to the racial unemployment gap also fails to reduce the gap.
abstract_zh: 黑人劳动者相较于白人劳动者面临更高且更不稳定的失业率，这一种族差异无法由可观测因素解释。一个包含摩擦性劳动力市场、内生性离职及雇主歧视的新凯恩斯模型解释了这些现象。我们利用该模型评估了不同货币政策策略如何按种族影响劳动力市场结果。若将货币政策规则调整为利率对就业水平与最大就业水平之间的缺口（而非偏离程度）作出反应，会导致通胀上升且无法缩小种族失业差距。而利率对种族失业缺口作出反应的货币政策规则同样未能缩小这一差距。
title: Labor Market Discrimination and the Racial Unemployment Gap: Can Monetary Policy Make a Difference?
title_zh: 劳动力市场歧视与种族失业差距：货币政策能否有所作为？

abstract: What drives the recent inflation surge? To answer this question, one must decompose inflation fluctuations into the contribution of structural shocks. We document how whimsical an historical shock decomposition can be in standard vector autoregressive (VAR) models. We show that the deterministic component of the VAR is imprecisely estimated, making the shock contributions poorly identified under general conditions. Our preferred approach to solve the problem—the single-unit-root prior—massively shrinks the uncertainty around the estimated deterministic component. Once this uncertainty is taken care of, demand shocks are the main drivers of the inflation surge in the United States, the euro area, and in four small open economies.
abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？要回答这一问题，需将通胀波动分解为结构性冲击的贡献。我们揭示了标准向量自回归（VAR）模型中历史冲击分解可能存在的随意性。研究表明，VAR模型中的确定性成分估计精度不足，导致在一般条件下冲击贡献的识别效果较差。我们提出的解决方案——单单位根先验——大幅压缩了估计确定性成分的不确定性。在消除这一不确定性后，需求冲击成为美国、欧元区及四个小型开放经济体通胀飙升的主要驱动因素。
title: What Drives the Recent Surge in Inflation? The Historical Decomposition Roller Coaster
title_zh: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？历史分解的过山车效应

abstract: This paper analyzes the effectiveness of a tax on inflation policy (TIP), which would require firms to pay a tax proportional to the increase in their prices or wages, in stabilizing inflation. We show that TIP would effectively correct externalities in firms’ pricing decisions, tackle excessive inflation and reduce output volatility. While proposals from the 1970s saw TIP as a substitute to MP, we find that they are complementary, with TIP addressing cost-push shocks, and MP addressing demand shocks. In sharp contrast with price controls, TIP doesn’t exacerbate relative price distortions.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了通胀税政策（TIP）在稳定通胀方面的有效性，该政策要求企业按其价格或工资上涨比例缴纳税款。研究表明，TIP能够有效纠正企业定价决策中的外部性，应对过度通胀并降低产出波动。尽管20世纪70年代的提案将TIP视为货币政策的替代方案，但我们发现二者具有互补性：TIP应对成本推动冲击，而货币政策应对需求冲击。与价格管制形成鲜明对比的是，TIP不会加剧相对价格扭曲。
title: Optimal Taxation of Inflation
title_zh: 通货膨胀的最优税收

abstract: We develop a simple quantitative New Keynesian model aimed at analyzing how the reaction of monetary policy contributed to the recent rise and fall in inflation. The model includes several shocks but features oil price shocks for two reasons: (i) energy prices have been among the central factors in discussions about the surge; (ii) we can use identified oil shocks along with monetary shocks to estimate and discipline the model. We then employ the estimated framework to recover shocks without targeting inflation. Both the oil shocks and the shocks to policy accommodation played important roles in the inflation rise.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约的定量新凯恩斯模型，旨在分析货币政策反应如何助推近期通胀的涨落。该模型包含多种冲击，但特别引入油价冲击，原因有二：（i）能源价格一直是通胀飙升讨论中的核心因素；（ii）我们可利用已识别的石油冲击与货币冲击对模型进行估计和约束。随后，我们运用该估计框架在不以通胀为目标的情况下反推各类冲击。研究显示，石油冲击与政策宽松冲击均在通胀上升过程中发挥了重要作用。
title: Oil Prices, Monetary Policy and Inflation Surges
title_zh: 油价、货币政策与通胀飙升

abstract: In less developed economies the allocation of factor inputs to more productive farms is often hindered. To analyze how distortions affect farm dynamics and agricultural productivity, we develop a model of heterogeneous farms investing in productivity improvements. We calibrate the model using detailed farm-level panel data from Vietnam, exploiting regional differences in agricultural institutions. We focus on south Vietnam and quantify the effect of higher measured distortions in the North. We find that the higher distortions in the North reduce agricultural productivity by 38%, accounting for 55% of the observed 2.5-fold difference between regions.
abstract_zh: 在欠发达经济体中，生产要素向高生产率农场的配置往往受到阻碍。为分析扭曲如何影响农场动态与农业生产力，我们构建了一个异质性农场投资于生产率改进的模型。利用越南详细的农场层面面板数据，我们借助农业制度的区域差异对模型进行校准。研究聚焦越南南方，并量化了北方地区较高测量扭曲的影响。结果表明，北方较高的扭曲导致农业生产力下降38%，这解释了观测到的区域间2.5倍生产力差异的55%。
title: Distortions, Producer Dynamics, and Aggregate Productivity: A General Equilibrium Analysis
title_zh: 扭曲、生产者动态与总生产率：一般均衡分析

abstract: Economic growth is typically measured in per capita terms. A long tradition in philosophy, however, suggests that social welfare may depend on the number of people as well. To illustrate how much this matters quantitatively, we decompose welfare growth — measured in consumption-equivalent (CE) units — into contributions from rising population and rising per capita consumption. Because of diminishing marginal utility from consumption, population growth is scaled up by a value-of-life factor that empirically averages nearly 3 across countries since 1960. Population increases are therefore a major contributor to growth if one takes a total utilitarian perspective.
abstract_zh: 经济增长通常以人均指标衡量。然而，哲学领域的悠久传统表明，社会福利可能同样取决于人口数量。为量化这一影响程度，我们将福利增长（以消费等价单位衡量）分解为人口增长与人均消费增长的贡献。由于消费边际效用递减，人口增长需乘以生命价值因子进行加权——该因子自1960年以来跨国实证均值接近3。因此，若采用总体功利主义视角，人口增长将成为经济增长的主要贡献因素。
title: Population and Welfare: Measuring Growth when Life is Worth Living
title_zh: 人口与福利：当生命值得生活时如何衡量增长
